CheckTitle: SQL Server Advanced Data Security is enabled
Description: Verify that Advanced Data Security is enabled on SQL Servers.
Risk: Advanced threats like SQL injection may go undetected without ADS.

Code.CLI: az sql server advanced-threat-protection-setting update -g <resource-group> -s <server-name> --state Enabled

Recommendation.Text: Review and implement the recommended configuration for Sqlserver Advanced Data Security Enabled.
